name: Witness (gas station on north side of highway, facing intersection at t=9.8s, looking at veh_A, eye 1.6m [standing])
claim: I watched the car the whole time until it hit the truck from the gas station on the north side of the highway.
assumptions: The gas station is not modeled in the scene, so the witness is placed north of the westbound lanes (z = -40 m, past the road edge at z = -35.1 m) aligned with the intersection (x = 0 m). Observation time is set to t = 9.8 s, just prior to the moment of impact.
